issues.description: The solution makes the Book.title property private (private let title: String) while the problem expects Book to have a accessible title (used when printing the inventory). This visibility prevents Client.main (in a different file) from accessing book.title and would cause a compilation error or confusion about how to implement printing. The problem statement describes a Book with a title and the client code (template/solution) uses book.title, so the title must not be private.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Book.title accessible to other files in the module by removing the private modifier (use `let title: String`) or use an appropriate access level such as fileprivate/internal/public. This keeps the property immutable (let) as required and allows Client.main to read and print the title.
